event.title: Protests Erupt in India Demanding Resignation of Election Chief
event.canonical_title: Protests Erupt in India Demanding Resignation of Election Chief
event.summary: A youth group known as the 'Cockroach' movement has threatened to resume mass protests unless Gyanesh Kumar resigns as head of India's election commission. This demand follows allegations of election rigging, which have also prompted opposition parties, including Congress, to join the protests. Police have responded with tear gas to disperse demonstrators.

timeline.title: Mass Protests Erupt in Madrid Over Housing Crisis Following Elderly Woman's Eviction
timeline.summary: Tens of thousands of people protested in Madrid against Spain's housing crisis after the eviction of an 87-year-old woman from her home of over 70 years. The incident has sparked widespread anger and calls for government action to address rising housing costs and prevent further evictions.
key_facts: 87-year-old woman evicted from her home of over 70 years
Protests involved tens of thousands of participants
Demonstrators called for measures to curb housing costs and evictions

timeline.title: Protests Erupt in Madrid Over Eviction of 87-Year-Old Resident
timeline.summary: In Madrid, protesters have camped in Puerta del Sol for a second night, creating a makeshift housing protest camp. This demonstration follows the eviction of 87-year-old María del Carmen Abascal, known as 'Maricarmen'. The protests highlight ongoing concerns regarding housing issues in the city.
